scenes.outline: People preparing parcel claim; A copies two fingers as two parcels, B meant two remembered features; A covers and compares layers.
Claim helpers; A copies four as time, B wrote route number; A covers and tests cafe-seat versus bus-seat claim.
Allotment helpers; A copies tape as permission to enter, B meant hazard; A recruits common cleanup-first account to committee.
Jam entrants; A copies inverted spoon as judging complete, B has dirty spoon; B refuses false strawberry authorship and A rehearses ambiguous recipe phrase.
Committee members; A mirrors turned page as anonymous question convention, B only using blank side; A asks B to test explanation without paper/name.
Family travel spenders; A copies step back as giving Dad space, B actually yielding doorway; A covers then sends B to test price/receipt reaction.
Expense helpers; A copies circle as solved proof, B means verify; duplicate payment confirmation lets A demand found-receipt credit.
House restorers; A copies wall cross as doorway found, B marks live wire; A retreats to diagram pointing Mum at wall and negotiates tour introduction.
Brothers; A copies B hand held out as pledge, B wants broken handle; A offers evidence without name then demands handshake before honest answer.
Business partners on client call; A copies button press but hangs up instead of muting; A covers then conditions callback truth on partnership.
